## Findings
- claim-1: Bounded independent check of partition conjugation: transpose preserves partition weight, exchanges r-by-q and q-by-r boxes, maps interval ideals for representative bigrassmannian tuples, and preserves degreewise quotient-rank/torsion signatures computed from complete Pieri relation matrices. Task-owned sandbox artifact `6b65b4554c22bf53938345f9e460abacf2db8628534848321f6f341af9d73f55` executed with exit status 0. Its persisted executable script has SHA-256 `2b414d7297dc1678479ccb202d60f406ae0de2ee8efc707355981ab0f68398c0`. Captured stdout preview: `INPUT n=2..10; all bigrassmannian (n,r,s,t) tuples CHECKED tuples=495 VERIFIED transpose preserves weight, box quotient bases, ideal intervals, and degreewise ideal ranks RESULT PASS`. Full captured output is immutable at `artifacts/computations/6b65b4554c22bf53938345f9e460abacf2db8628534848321f6f341af9d73f55/artifact.json` in JSON fields `fullOutput.stdout.content` (SHA-256 `d303d3b6e402392d4585e30fe14509f48d2e6eb1c82dac695fbe6e95e8a0eed3`) and `fullOutput.stderr.content` (SHA-256 `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`). [artifact 6b65b4554c22bf53938345f9e460abacf2db8628534848321f6f341af9d73f55]
- claim-2: This bounded computation does not by itself establish any unchecked all-parameter or parent-theorem claim.
## Strategy
Conditionally on accepted quotient conjugation and ideal correspondence, \(\Omega(\bar s_\lambda)=\bar s_{\lambda'}\) is an integral grading-preserving isomorphism \(A\to A^\vee\), with \(\Omega(J_v)=J_{v^\vee}\) and \(\Omega(A_+)=A^\vee_+\). Hence it descends to
\[
J_v/A_+J_v\cong J_{v^\vee}/A^\vee_+J_{v^\vee}.
\]
Degreewise isomorphisms preserve integral torsion subgroups and free \(\mathbb Z\)-ranks. This conditional mathematical corollary is established in internal artifact `3e8f0b94dfe273a1b6d9eec5a1e7d5e3bc8a404e0a0fbcf8548b9c221e587c22@L14-L48`.

## Gaps
The required quotient-level computation capability certificate is not established. No task-owned artifact was supplied or executed that constructs both \((A_+J_v)_d\) and \((A^\vee_+J_{v^\vee})_d\), computes both Smith forms, and compares degreewise ranks and torsion. Artifact `6b65b4554c22bf53938345f9e460abacf2db8628534848321f6f341af9d73f55` does not provide this.

Thus the scoped certificate is incomplete despite the conditional formal corollary.
